plan.goal: Explore and critique the UX of harborwallet-mobile, focusing on the settings/privacy flow and adjacent pages/states, validating interactables, layout, and responsiveness.
plan.summary: Start on the home page, explore key interactables (tabs, buttons, links), validate mobile responsiveness, check for layout issues, and ensure all known pages are covered. Prioritize the Account tab for settings/privacy flow, then adjacent flows like Send/Receive/Activity.
assumptions: The app is a single-page application with all content in index.html.
Interactables (buttons, links) trigger state changes or navigation within the app.
Mobile viewport (≤460px) renders edge-to-edge as per prescan.
risk_hotspots: Small tap targets (e.g., '3 🔔', 'See all') as per layout warnings.
Account tab (potential settings/privacy flow) — need to validate depth of settings.
Mobile responsiveness — ensure all elements are accessible and visible on small viewports.

phases.title: Home Page Exploration
phases.objective: Validate home page interactables, layout, and initial state.
key_checks: Click '⌂ Home' (validate active state).
Click '↑ Send' (validate state change/modal).
Click '↓ Receive' (validate state change/modal).
Click '⇄ Swap' (validate state change/modal).
Click '+ Top up' (validate state change/modal).
Check '3 🔔' (validate notification state/modal).
Check 'See all' (validate activity list expansion).
Validate layout on desktop viewport (initial observation).
exit_criteria: All home page interactables checked (buttons: '⌂ Home', '↑ Send', '↓ Receive', '⇄ Swap', '+ Top up', '3 🔔', 'See all').
Layout issues (small tap targets) noted for follow-up in mobile phase.

phases.title: Adjacent Flows (Send/Receive/Activity)
phases.objective: Explore adjacent flows (Send, Receive, Activity) to validate state changes and interactables.
key_checks: Click '↑ Send' (validate Send flow: form, inputs, cancel/confirm).
Click '↓ Receive' (validate Receive flow: address, QR, cancel/confirm).
Click '📊 Activity' (validate Activity page: list, filters, 'See all' expansion).
Check '⌂ Home' to return to home state.
exit_criteria: Send, Receive, and Activity flows validated (state changes, interactables).
All relevant buttons (Send, Receive, Activity) checked for functionality.

phases.title: Account (Settings/Privacy) Flow
phases.objective: Explore the Account tab to validate settings/privacy flow depth and interactables.
key_checks: Click '◉ Account' (validate Account page: settings, privacy, profile).
Check for sub-menus/settings (e.g., privacy, security, profile).
Validate back navigation to home/other tabs.
exit_criteria: Account tab explored (settings/privacy flow validated for depth).
All Account tab interactables checked (button: '◉ Account').

phases.title: Mobile Responsiveness Check
phases.objective: Validate mobile viewport (≤460px) layout, interactables, and accessibility.
key_checks: Switch to mobile viewport (≤460px).
Validate edge-to-edge rendering (chassis, status bar, tab bar).
Check small tap targets ('3 🔔', 'See all') for accessibility (tap area, visibility).
Re-validate key interactables (Send, Receive, Account, Home) on mobile.
Check for layout issues (e.g., overlapping elements, truncated text).
exit_criteria: Small tap target issues re-checked on mobile (severity, usability).

phases.title: Final Validation & Coverage
phases.objective: Ensure all known pages (index.html) are covered, all features exercised, and final checks for console/network errors.
key_checks: Re-visit all phases to ensure no interactables missed.
Check console/network errors (should be none per prescan).
Validate all headings (YOUR ASSETS, RECENT ACTIVITY, etc.) are associated with relevant content.
Final check for layout warnings (small tap targets) — document severity and impact.

coverage_targets.pages: Visit index.html (only known page) and explore all states/flows within it.
coverage_targets.features: Exercise all visible controls (39 buttons, 1 link, 1 input) per key page (home, send, receive, activity, account).
coverage_targets.mobile: Repeat critical checks (interactables, layout) on mobile viewport (≤460px).

notes: Since it's a single-page app, all exploration happens within index.html. Focus on state changes (modals, tabs) rather than page navigation.
